decisive_items: Avid irregular enhancement within the right cavernous sinus and enlargement of the right side compared with the left
response.rationale: Tolosa-Hunt syndrome is the most likely diagnosis due to the combination of headache, diplopia, and cranial nerve palsies, along with the imaging findings of irregular enhancement in the right cavernous sinus.

rejected.why: Sphenoid sinusitis is less likely due to the lack of other symptoms such as fever or nasal discharge.
Giant cell arteritis is less likely due to the normal inflammatory markers.
Metastatic prostate cancer is less likely due to the lack of other metastatic lesions.
Sarcoidosis is less likely due to the lack of other systemic symptoms.
Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma is less likely due to the lack of other lymphoma-related symptoms.
